## Planned $10 market buy of NVDA

The command to run would be:

```
pod trade buy NVDA --usd 10 --market
```

This plans (does not send) a market buy of NVDA perp sized to $10 at the current mark price (~$151.85). The plan output will show the exact size, worst-case price, fee, and margin needed. Sending would require a separate `pod trade send PLAN_ID` step after approval.
